top_hypotheses.title: Electrical resonance changes amplitude and phase while preserving a complete energy budget
top_hypotheses.theory: A passive lumped circuit moves energy between fields and dissipates resistance loss.
top_hypotheses.inspiration: Tesla source/load apparatus descriptions and established electrical resonance.
top_hypotheses.model: W_in=Δ(0.5 L I²+0.5 C Vc²)+∫R I²dt+W_load for the declared fixed-parameter circuit.
top_hypotheses.rival: Incomplete time windows, sign mistakes, current/voltage channel skew or uncounted source/initial energy produce apparent excess.
top_hypotheses.observable: Signed instantaneous power, integrated joules, endpoint stored energy and residual as time step shrinks.
top_hypotheses.control: Source-off decay, known added resistance, phase/skew adversary, nonzero initial energy and held-out integration resolution.
top_hypotheses.materials: Simulation first; optional current-limited low-voltage source, resistor, inductor, capacitor and synchronized voltage/current logging.
top_hypotheses.falsifier: A claimed excess collapses under complete accounting; a model fails if a calibrated residual exceeds its predeclared uncertainty.
top_hypotheses.novelty_status: Established conservation exercise, not a new energy source.
top_hypotheses.status: Active source recommendation; numerical execution belongs to advisor ledger

top_hypotheses.title: Motion-dependent inductance exchanges source energy with field energy and mechanical work
top_hypotheses.theory: A linear lossless magnetic constitutive model with L(z) has a force obtained from magnetic coenergy at fixed current.
top_hypotheses.inspiration: Tesla source/load boundary and current force-metrology requirements.
top_hypotheses.model: v=R I+L dI/dt+I(dL/dz)zdot; Fz=0.5 I² dL/dz. Hence vI−RI²=d(0.5LI²)/dt+Fz zdot.
top_hypotheses.rival: Omitting motional back-emf or treating fixed-current coenergy as fixed-flux energy doubles or changes the inferred work.
top_hypotheses.observable: Voltage/current/position work integrals and independently differentiated force; force is even under I reversal in this specific model.
top_hypotheses.control: Reverse motion/current separately, source-off, fixed-position and zero-gradient cases; finite-difference force check.
top_hypotheses.materials: Simulation; later a low-voltage coil, constrained moving core, position readout and calibrated force gauge.
top_hypotheses.falsifier: An omitted-term variant fails closure while the complete model converges; parity alone cannot identify gravity change.
top_hypotheses.novelty_status: Standard electromechanics applied to a transparent counterexample.
top_hypotheses.status: Prospective R4 candidate; assumptions exclude hysteresis/saturation/unknown permanent bias

top_hypotheses.title: An apparent weight change can be ordinary lift or interaction with the source support
top_hypotheses.theory: A scale senses support force; magnetic force on a sample can alter its reading without changing gravitational acceleration.
top_hypotheses.inspiration: Diamagnetic levitation experiments and steady-field null studies.
top_hypotheses.model: N=m g−Fmag,z for the sample; include the source reaction in the complete supported system. A separately characterized weakly magnetic witness adds information on g only within its coupling bounds.
top_hypotheses.rival: Thermal drift, lead forces, induced magnetic response, electrostatic pickup and source support outside the weighed boundary.
top_hypotheses.observable: Sample/source support forces, field gradient, reference response and all-run null distribution.
top_hypotheses.control: Independent support/reaction witness, move source versus sample, matched heating, current reversal, sample swap and blinded order.
top_hypotheses.materials: Simulation first; later magnet/coil, nonmagnetic stand, scale/force sensor and optical position reference.
top_hypotheses.falsifier: A gravity-only attribution fails when signal tracks susceptibility/geometry or cancels with the source reaction; unresolved residual remains unresolved.
top_hypotheses.novelty_status: Measurement-design hypothesis, not proof of antigravity.
top_hypotheses.status: Active R5 candidate; no measured force or gravity result in this lane

top_hypotheses.title: Magnetic levitation stability has testable ordinary stiffness and damping
top_hypotheses.theory: Static diamagnetism and rotating-magnet stabilization have different restoring-force and dissipative mechanisms.
top_hypotheses.model: Linearize declared Fmag(z)−mg near an equilibrium, or integrate gravity+dipole torque+inertia with a driven source.
top_hypotheses.rival: Unmodeled air damping, image scale/parallax, finite magnet geometry or phase aliasing.
top_hypotheses.observable: Equilibrium position, small-displacement stiffness, amplitude-dependent frequency and loss.
top_hypotheses.control: Geometry variation, independent optical scale, stationary-source and no-gradient limits.
top_hypotheses.materials: Simulation is cheapest; stationary contained magnets plus pre-cut graphite for a later qualitative demonstration.
top_hypotheses.falsifier: A proposed model fails to predict withheld equilibrium/stability changes within declared approximation error.
top_hypotheses.novelty_status: Established magnetic lift; a good model benchmark, not gravity cancellation.
top_hypotheses.status: Secondary priority; no exposed high-speed magnet prototype selected

top_hypotheses.title: A proposed asymmetric electrostatic force needs the full momentum boundary
top_hypotheses.theory: For a closed apparatus, partial surface forces are insufficient; include all electrodes, power supply, field momentum and environment.
top_hypotheses.inspiration: Buhler/Aurigema patent claims, bounded against NASA gas-force observations.
top_hypotheses.model: In a static isolated model, closed-surface Maxwell-stress flux accounts for total electromagnetic force; external walls or gas can exchange momentum.
top_hypotheses.rival: Ion wind, leakage, cable reaction, chamber attraction, thermal outgassing and numerical boundary truncation.
top_hypotheses.observable: Closed versus partial force integral, dependence on wall distance and gas nuisance, measured detection threshold.
top_hypotheses.control: Enlarge numerical boundary, include return electrode/source, reverse geometry and make matched-heat dummy.
top_hypotheses.materials: Electrostatic simulation/document review only at this stage.
top_hypotheses.falsifier: A putative isolated thrust vanishes when omitted surfaces or external momentum are included; any surviving residual requires independent calibrated data.
top_hypotheses.novelty_status: Claim audit; the patent is not independent performance evidence.
top_hypotheses.status: Unselected high-voltage hardware; no validated extraordinary model

top_hypotheses.title: A cavity-induced material change is a different claim from gravity change or net generated work
top_hypotheses.theory: Material phase observables, mechanical force and usable work require separate measurements and models.
top_hypotheses.inspiration: 2026 NbSe2 primary abstract surfaced by a fringe research-log lead.
top_hypotheses.model: Track transition temperature separately from a closed energy or force budget; no cross-domain implication is assumed.
top_hypotheses.rival: Sample variation, geometry/calibration changes or overinterpretation of a materials result as a propulsion result.
top_hypotheses.observable: Reproduced transition curve and specified control geometry, then separately measured force/work if claimed.
top_hypotheses.control: Read full methods, retain same-device controls and resolve abstract percentage inconsistency before numerical reuse.
top_hypotheses.materials: Document review; cryogenic THz equipment exceeds least-material priority.
top_hypotheses.falsifier: A transition shift alone cannot identify an added force or net delivered energy; each stronger hypothesis needs its own falsifiable prediction.
top_hypotheses.novelty_status: Current primary lead, abstract-only; no replication or new theory in this project.

sound_hypotheses.title: The measured decay may include changing acquisition gain
sound_hypotheses.theory: A physical exponential envelope multiplied by time-varying gain has a different apparent slope.
sound_hypotheses.inspiration: Tesla’s explicit source/load distinction; current AGC engineering; v3 gain-identifiability gap.
sound_hypotheses.model: s(t)=g(t) A exp(-alpha*t); stable reference r(t)=g(t) R. With shared gain and constant R, d(log r)/dt-d(log s)/dt=alpha.
sound_hypotheses.rival: The reference itself drifts or receives different processing, so cancellation is biased.
sound_hypotheses.observable: Signal and reference log-envelope slopes in s^-1, witness mismatch and held-out residual.
sound_hypotheses.control: Stable same-chain reference, gain-change positive control, reference-drift and frequency-dependent-gain failures.
sound_hypotheses.materials: Synthetic files first; later one recorder, sound source and independently characterized reference path.
sound_hypotheses.falsifier: Correction fails outside frozen tolerance when an independently measured same-chain stable witness should apply.
sound_hypotheses.novelty_status: Standard common-mode cancellation; project contribution is falsifiable boundary testing, not a new law.
sound_hypotheses.status: Recommended; actual v4 contract/ledger decides execution

sound_hypotheses.title: A room or resonator may contain several observable modes
sound_hypotheses.theory: The microphone receives a weighted sum of damped modes, reflections and sensor filtering.
sound_hypotheses.inspiration: Newton’s competing-cause method; v3 total-transfer ambiguity; measured UPV room data.
sound_hypotheses.model: y(t)=sum_j a_j exp(-alpha_j*t) cos(omega_j*t+phi_j)+noise, after the declared source/receiver filter.
sound_hypotheses.rival: A single intrinsic decay is claimed from a convenient fit window.
sound_hypotheses.observable: Window/band sensitivity, held-out prediction, multiple spatial records and residual structure.
sound_hypotheses.control: Single-mode positive control; two-mode beat control; source-off noise and repeated unchanged placement.
sound_hypotheses.materials: Existing WAV files; later inert resonator, padded support, recorder and marked positions.
sound_hypotheses.falsifier: A prespecified single-mode model consistently predicts independent windows/positions within calibrated uncertainty, weakening the need for the added mode over that range.
sound_hypotheses.novelty_status: Established modal acoustics; useful contribution is a tested estimator-rejection boundary.
sound_hypotheses.status: Proposed; external RIR payload was not acquired

sound_hypotheses.title: Clock mismatch can look like acoustic change
sound_hypotheses.theory: Playback and record clocks define different time maps, altering a recovered sweep response.
sound_hypotheses.inspiration: Known metrology rather than a privileged frequency interpretation.
sound_hypotheses.model: Measured sample time t_r=a*t+b, with dimensionless rate a and offset b in seconds; account for interpolation error.
sound_hypotheses.rival: The fitted frequency or decay shift belongs to the resonator.
sound_hypotheses.observable: Reference pulse timing, fitted rate ratio, corrected and uncorrected response.
sound_hypotheses.control: Shared clock versus known injected drift; independent timing witness; nonlinear-drift failure.
sound_hypotheses.materials: Software resampling first; a synchronized audio loopback only if equipment supports it.
sound_hypotheses.falsifier: An independent timing witness excludes the drift needed to explain the observed change.
sound_hypotheses.novelty_status: Bryan et al.2010 already develop clock compensation; no priority claim.

sound_hypotheses.title: Visible sound patterns depend on the apparatus as well as frequency
sound_hypotheses.theory: Boundary conditions, fill depth, forcing and illumination affect a liquid or plate pattern.
sound_hypotheses.inspiration: Cymatics/sacred-geometry discourse translated into a controlled mode-selection question.
sound_hypotheses.model: Forced bounded-wave or shallow-fluid model with declared geometry; response may be subharmonic rather than equal to drive.
sound_hypotheses.rival: A single frequency uniquely identifies one universal shape or a biological signature.
sound_hypotheses.observable: Repeatable pattern descriptors under a fixed camera pipeline; drive/response frequencies measured separately.
sound_hypotheses.control: Same-frequency depth/geometry intervention, return condition, source-off baseline, fixed lighting and camera rate.
sound_hypotheses.materials: Future water vessel and isolated low-level mechanical drive; numerical geometry comparison first. No high-power levitator needed.
sound_hypotheses.falsifier: Claim of universal frequency-only pattern fails if controlled boundary/depth changes alter the pattern beyond repeatability.
sound_hypotheses.novelty_status: Established driven-wave principle; no genetic or therapeutic inference from geometry.
sound_hypotheses.status: Lower-priority proposal; no current physical video

sound_hypotheses.title: An alchemical name constrains candidates but does not identify a sample
sound_hypotheses.theory: Textual names and visual changes form a many-to-one observation map over possible compounds and phases.
sound_hypotheses.inspiration: Selected Newton notebook and scholarly decoding alternatives.
sound_hypotheses.model: Candidate set C(text,context); observation map f:C→features. An independent witness must separate remaining candidates.
sound_hypotheses.rival: Every planetary sign or colour maps to one pure modern element.
sound_hypotheses.observable: Documented passage alternatives; reference elemental/phase features and unresolved equivalence classes.
sound_hypotheses.control: Hold out passages; include ambiguous names and intentionally duplicated measurement channels.
sound_hypotheses.materials: Digital manuscripts, curated reference data and ordinary computation; no toxic chemical reproduction.
sound_hypotheses.falsifier: A proposed unique identity is invalidated by another chemically plausible candidate matching all admitted observations.
sound_hypotheses.novelty_status: Source curation and inverse-problem demonstration; not a new element or transmutation.
sound_hypotheses.status: Dictionary delivered; no historical sample assayed

sound_hypotheses.title: A suspected boundary mechanism can fail without establishing an exotic replacement
sound_hypotheses.theory: Specific acoustic geometry can be tested and rejected within a bounded apparatus.
sound_hypotheses.inspiration: NASA’s explicit failed wall-resonance explanation; ancient-levitation rumor lead.
sound_hypotheses.model: Predict force/response under a defined boundary intervention with complete source energy and ordinary coupling.
sound_hypotheses.rival: An unexplained residual is assigned directly to gravity change or source-free energy.
sound_hypotheses.observable: A predeclared force or pressure contrast with nuisance bounds.
sound_hypotheses.control: Mechanism-disabled reference, matched thermal/input-power conditions and complete null outcomes.
sound_hypotheses.materials: Paper/data analysis only in this low-material program; no high-power ultrasound build.
sound_hypotheses.falsifier: An ordinary calibrated model explains the claimed residual; alternatively a purported exotic model fails its quantitative distinct prediction.
sound_hypotheses.novelty_status: No distinct extraordinary prediction has been supplied; retain as an unselected lead.
